name: Conquiste o Sayexxx
source:
This game is a parody done in honor of our friend Saymon, where the goal is to win this pimp.
[From [url=https://jabasow.itch.io/conquiste-o-sayexxx] itch.io[/url]]
translation:
这是一款为向朋友赛蒙致敬而制作的恶搞游戏，目标是赢得这位皮条客。

（来源：[url=https://jabasow.itch.io/conquiste-o-sayexxx]itch.io[/url]）
